checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja identifies App_ContextSetDebugged at 0x0048F1A0; the address-qualified GameNatives body and candidate target the same entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail MOVSX EAX, byte ptr [ESP+4] sign-extends the first cdecl byte argument. The candidate accepts std::int8_t and promotes it to std::int32_t.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The retail body applies no constants or scaling; it stores and returns the promoted input unchanged.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail writes EAX to 0x005C8BF8. The port maps this global to AppContextState::debugged and stores the same 32-bit value; absolute-address storage is represented by the port-owned state object.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The retail body has no calls and one global write. The candidate has no calls and one corresponding state-field write.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The retail RET leaves the MOVSX result in EAX, with no branch or error path. The candidate returns that same promoted value.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The function uses integer operations only.

limits: The retail x86 function was executed in Radare2 ESIL rather than inside a live IGI.exe process.
The candidate was compiled from the current source and compared over every possible signed-byte input.
Retail absolute storage at 0x005C8BF8 maps to the port-owned AppContextState::debugged field.
